metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: Mapped ordered off-diagonal cosine over at most 2048 real embeddings, seed 42. PAD/MASK excluded. 0.5 means approximately zero cosine; neither collapse nor quality is established.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:training_margins: Pooled positive-minus-negative logits at verified supervised MASK positions in at most ten cloned already-consumed batches. Mean, nearest-rank p10 and rates below 0 and 0.5; in-sample, scale-dependent measurements.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:sampler_contract: Checks shapes, reserved tokens and all-MASK supervision in cached batches; cannot establish source provenance or proposal probabilities.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:candidate_audit: Retrospective training-prefix candidate-composition sensitivity. Each available regime uses target plus 99 unique prefix/target-excluded real items. Frequencies use complete training histories; bands are zero, [1,4), [4,16), [16,64), [64,256), [256,infinity). Text regimes require nonzero target text and use nonzero-text eligible negatives. Lexical support is the top 500 strictly positive TF-IDF similarities, ordered by descending similarity then ascending ID. Histogram controls exclude that entire pool and match six frequency counts exactly. Diagnostic rank uses descending neural score then ascending item ID. Margin is target minus tenth-highest negative; percentile=(rank-1)/99. Contrast signs are right minus left. Each contrast requires three complete paired draws/user; user means receive equal weight. 500 seed-42 user bootstrap replicates condition on checkpoint, selected support and fixed draws, excluding seed/search uncertainty and candidate-draw variability. Three per-draw means/std/range describe coarse draw variability separately. Shared-item dependence and support selection remain limitations. No causal semantic, temporal-generalization, relevance or host-validation claim follows. TF-IDF/frequencies construct diagnostic candidates only and never contribute serving scores. Missing authoritative mapping or current serialized parity evidence makes comparisons unavailable.
